first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Weapon A
entities.identification: The dark blue-black long gun in the lower-right foreground, with a long box-shaped main body, a broad flat top cover, and silver-gray edge lines visible; its lower portion is cropped by the frame.

entities.name: layered rock wall
entities.identification: The tall greenish-brown rock walls enclosing the narrow passage, with horizontally undulating strata, protruding angular bends, and localized bright yellowish-brown rock surfaces.

entities.name: gray-green passage floor
entities.identification: The gray-green ground extending into the depth of the image between the layered rock walls on both sides, with relatively smooth surface texture and boundaries that follow the bends of the rock walls.

entities.name: blue sky opening
entities.identification: The small, bright blue area visible through the gap between the tops of the rock walls.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: Person A is the man in a dark uniform in the passage; in the first frame of this clip, only a small part of Person A's head is visible at the upper left edge, after which Person A exits the frame.

entities.name: white cloud of smoke
entities.identification: The grayish-white vertical mass in front of the rock wall on the left, with a roughly irregular oval outline, soft edges, and uneven internal density.

entities.name: red stain
entities.identification: The small, narrow dark-red fragment slightly left of center along the bottom edge in frame 0, near the boundary of the rock wall on the left.
